description: Claims that Phase 2+ Pi skills must NOT assume. UNKNOWN means not established by official sources — do not treat as false unless an official source explicitly refutes it. UNSUPPORTED means the assumption contradicts verified official documentation or is explicitly out of MVP scope per Phase 0.4/0.5.

claims.claim: Pi authentication is an OAuth2 authorization-code / redirect identity provider comparable to Google OAuth.
claims.reason: Official docs specify Pi.authenticate(scopes, onIncompletePaymentFound) in the frontend SDK and server verification via GET /v2/me — not an OAuth2 redirect IdP flow.

claims.claim: Pi identity can be wired as a drop-in OpenSail Google/GitHub-style OAuth provider for Studio login in MVP.
claims.reason: Phase 0.5 freezes Studio-native Pi login as a non-goal. Official Pi auth targets Pi apps in Pi Browser / sandbox, not OpenSail platform auth.

claims.claim: Pi payments are equivalent to Stripe Checkout / subscriptions.
claims.reason: Official U2A flow is createPayment → server approve → on-chain user submit → server complete with txid. Not a Stripe-like provider.

claims.claim: Pi payments deliver Stripe-style signed webhooks for fulfillment.
claims.reason: Reviewed official payment docs describe client SDK callbacks plus server Platform API approve/complete. No Stripe-equivalent webhook protocol was verified.

claims.claim: Official Pi Platform API supports payment refunds.
claims.reason: Refund endpoints/flows were not present in the verified platform_API.md / payments.md surfaces.

claims.claim: Official Pi Platform API supports recurring / subscription billing.
claims.reason: Recurring billing was not documented in the verified payment sources.

claims.claim: Pi App Studio exposes a public API for external tools.
claims.reason: Official App Studio material is product-announcement class. No public App Studio create/deploy/publish API has been confirmed.

claims.claim: Pi App Studio provides a documented deploy API for automation.
claims.reason: No confirmed public deploy API; deployment for custom apps is self-host URL + Developer Portal configuration.

claims.claim: Pi App Studio provides a documented publish API for automation.
claims.reason: No confirmed public publish API in verified sources.

claims.claim: There is an official public Pi wallet balance API for third-party apps beyond documented payment scopes/flows.
claims.reason: Verified docs document wallet_address scope and payment DTOs; a general balance API was not confirmed.

claims.claim: There is an official public Pi wallet history API for third-party apps.
claims.reason: Not present in the verified Platform API route list.

claims.claim: Third-party apps may take custody of user wallet passphrases or keys via an official API.
claims.reason: Official app guidelines state apps may never request Pioneers to enter their passphrase.

claims.claim: Official docs define a refresh-token protocol for Pi access tokens comparable to OAuth refresh tokens.
claims.reason: UserDTO includes credentials.valid_until; a refresh-token protocol was not documented in verified sources.

claims.claim: There is an official Pi Core Team Python backend SDK.
claims.reason: payments_advanced.md lists Python as TBD / Community-maintained. Ruby is officially supported; Node.js marked Coming soon.

claims.claim: An npm package (e.g. pi-sdk-js) is the required official frontend SDK install path.
claims.reason: Official platform-docs specify loading https://sdk.minepi.com/pi-sdk.js into the page. Community npm wrappers are not normative install requirements.

claims.claim: App-To-User (A2U) payments are available on Mainnet.
claims.reason: payments_advanced.md states A2U is currently available only on the Testnet. Do not infer Mainnet A2U.

claims.claim: OpenSail desktop/project preview is equivalent to production Pi Browser execution.
claims.reason: Official docs target Pi Browser for production; sandbox.minepi.com is the documented desktop development path. OpenSail preview must not claim full Pi Browser fidelity.

claims.claim: Setting Pi.init({ sandbox: true/false }) switches a Developer Portal app between Testnet and Mainnet.
claims.reason: Sandbox is an SDK/host mode; Testnet/Mainnet are Developer Portal app network registrations. These axes must not be collapsed.
